name: Writesonic
shortDescription: Content and brand-tracking plans. Starter is $79 per month billed annually.
longDescription: Writesonic's pricing page lists a Starter plan at $79 per month when billed annually, and says it tracks a brand across chat products and Google AI Overviews. We did not subscribe.
